main_text.p: factum est, quàm eas publicè omnium exponere.

Cùm verò secus vellet Providentia, haud utique molestè fero Pectus meum (quod Divinæ Omniscientiæ approba- restudeo ) palam jam coram Mundo retectum fieri, fine fucis illis omnibus & speciosis ad populum ornamentis, quæ in Publicis Epistolis & Orationibus solent. Vtinam vel in penitissimos animi mei sensus introspicere liceret Subditis meis; certe nil aliud deprehenderent, quàm quâ curâ & amore distractus sim, non quo Iura mea magis, quàm ut pacem eorum & fœlicitatem confervem, & quàm ingenti mœrore conficior, eos ita in perniciem suam delusos.

Nec quicquam amplius ex his literis malevolentia ullius confecuta est, quam, quod omnibus notum fecerim quàm constanti animo fuerim in Vxorem meam, Leges, & Religionem; Mella legent apes, ubi virus fugit Franca.

Quod explicare me voluerim angustiis (in quas me Hostes adegerant) licitis & honestis Foederationibus initis, nemo sane vituperabit qui me amat & Rempublicam, cùm haud fieri omnino posfit, ut sint fœlices Subditi Mei Me misero, vel pace sua & Immunitatibus Me oppresso potiantur.

page.notes: The running head is Greek capitals with some Latin-looking letters as printed; I normalised it to ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. The long s is transcribed as s throughout. The word "restudeo" is read from "reftudeo" with the ligature, and "angustiis" from "anguftiis". Italic words are marked where they are visibly set in italic. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
